summary: Russia launched a massive combined drone and missile attack across Ukraine on October 18, 2026, involving Shahed drones, Geran-5 missiles, and ballistic missile threats from northern directions. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets over Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and western regions, with strikes reported on energy infrastructure in Rivne, Ternopil, and Lviv oblasts. Simultaneously, Ukrainian drones struck targets in Saint Petersburg, including an oil terminal and data center.
key_points: Russian forces launched Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv, Sumy, Zhytomyr, and other directions toward Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Rivne, and central Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149)
Ballistic missile threat detected from Bryansk, Kursk, and Millerovo with potential salvo of ~30 Iskander-M/S-400/Zircon missiles targeting Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/124211)
Ukrainian air raid alerts activated in Kyiv at red (missile) and yellow (drone) levels, with multiple all-clears issued. (Source: @eRadarrua/124215, @eRadarrua/124216)
Russian strikes hit energy infrastructure in Rivne, Ternopil, and Lviv oblasts, causing fires and damaging 9 private homes in Lviv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/124213)
Ukrainian drones attacked Saint Petersburg overnight, hitting a railway bridge, oil terminal, VK data center, and substation, causing power outages. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)
US intelligence warns of massive Russian strike within 48 hours with 24 ballistic missiles accumulated at launch sites. (Source: @UkraineNow/84749)
Drone launches reported from Orel (5 groups), Guardiyskoye (2 groups), Millerovo (4 groups). (Source: @eRadarrua/124212)
Geran-5 missiles struck Poltava, Zhytomyr, Kyiv (Desnyanskyi district), Rivne, and Khmelnytskyi areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77181, @mon1tor_ua/77175, @mon1tor_ua/77180, @mon1tor_ua/77187)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive combined drone and missile attack across Ukraine on October 18, 2026, involving Shahed drones, Geran-5 missiles, and ballistic missile threats from northern directions. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets over Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and western regions, with strikes reported on energy infrastructure in Rivne, Ternopil, and Lviv oblasts. Simultaneously, Ukrainian drones struck targets in Saint Petersburg, including an oil terminal and data center.

points: Ukrainian drones conducted a large-scale overnight attack on Saint Petersburg, striking a railway bridge, oil terminal in the port, VK data center, and a substation, causing power outages in the city and region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)

Ukrainian air defense forces engaged incoming Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles across multiple oblasts, with air raid alerts activated in Kyiv at both red (missile) and yellow (drone) threat levels. (Source: @eRadarrua/124215, @eRadarrua/124216)

Ukrainian monitoring channels tracked Russian drone launch sites at Orel (5 groups), Guardiyskoye (2 groups), and Millerovo (4 groups), providing early warning for air defense deployment. (Source: @eRadarrua/124212)

Ukrainian officials acknowledged US intelligence warning of a potential massive Russian ballistic missile strike within 48 hours, with 24 missiles (Iskander, S-400, Oniks, Zircon) prepared at launch positions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84749)

Russian forces launched a coordinated wave of Shahed-type drones from multiple directions: 7 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod), 2 from Sumy to Chernihiv (Pryluky), 1 from Zhytomyr to Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka), 1 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi, 1 near Kremenchuk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia), 1 from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Bila Tserkva), and 1 near Kropyvnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149)

Russian Geran-5 missiles (rocket-powered drones) struck targets in Poltava, Zhytomyr (two missiles), Kyiv (Desnyanskyi district), Rivne (multiple impacts near Zdolbuniv, Kvasyliv), and Khmelnytskyi (Yampil, Bilohirya), with some approaching the Khmelnytskyi Nuclear Power Plant. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77181, @mon1tor_ua/77175, @mon1tor_ua/77180, @mon1tor_ua/77187, @mon1tor_ua/77178)

Russian ballistic missile threat emerged from Bryansk, Kursk, and Millerovo areas, with a potential salvo of approximately 30 Iskander-M/S-400/Zircon missiles targeting Kyiv and surrounding region overnight. (Source: @eRadarrua/124211, @mon1tor_ua/77150)

Russian drone launches originated from Orel (5 groups), Guardiyskoye (2 groups), and Millerovo (4 groups), indicating a large-scale preparation for sustained aerial attacks. (Source: @eRadarrua/124212)

Russian strikes hit civilian and energy infrastructure in western Ukraine: a production facility in Rivne ceased operations, fires broke out at energy facilities in Ternopil, and a logistics complex in Muravane (Lviv) was hit with 9 private homes damaged. (Source: @eRadarrua/124213)

Russian strike groups (Udarny Bp) were detected in Kharkiv (2 groups), Sumy (1 group), Dnipropetrovsk (3 groups), Zaporizhzhia (1 group), and Kherson (1 group) oblasts, indicating ongoing offensive operations along the eastern and southern frontlines. (Source: @eRadarrua/124209, @eRadarrua/124218)

A 'Banderol' missile (likely a Kh-59/69 type) was tracked moving through Poltava toward Orzhytsia, suggesting continued Russian use of air-launched cruise missiles against rear-area targets. (Source: @kpszsu/88065)

Russian reactive drones (Reaktivny BpLA) operated near the frontlines in Mykolaiv (Veselynove, Ochakiv from Black Sea) and Kherson directions, likely performing reconnaissance or strike missions. (Source: @kpszsu/88007, @kpszsu/88052)
Russian air defense activity was reported over Chernihiv oblast, possibly engaging Ukrainian drones or missiles near the border. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77148)

Ballistic missile launch threat from Bryansk, Kursk, and Millerovo (Russia) with up to 30 Iskander-M/S-400/Zircon missiles aimed at Kyiv, prompting red-level air raid alerts in the capital. (Source: @eRadarrua/124211, @mon1tor_ua/77150)
Massive Shahed drone incursions from Chernihiv (7 drones to Vyshhorod/Kyiv), Sumy (2 drones to Pryluky/Chernihiv), and a Geran-5 missile from Chernihiv to Vyshhorod/Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149)

Russian drone launch sites at Orel (5 groups), Guardiyskoye (2 groups), and Millerovo (4 groups) activated, feeding drones into northern and northeastern Ukrainian airspace. (Source: @eRadarrua/124212)

Reactive drones transited Chernihiv oblast toward Kyiv reservoir and Slavutych, with additional drones over Chornobyl exclusion zone heading to Zhytomyr. (Source: @kpszsu/88041, @kpszsu/88038, @kpszsu/88048)
Russian strike groups (Udarny Bp) operated in Chernihiv (4-6 groups) and Sumy (1-3 groups) oblasts, maintaining pressure on northern border regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/124210, @eRadarrua/124218)
Reactive drones from Odesa oblast (via Black Sea) moved toward Mykolaiv (Ochakiv) and Vinnytsia, indicating Russian naval drone operations from the Black Sea. (Source: @kpszsu/88052, @kpszsu/88061)

Russian drones over Mykolaiv oblast at Veselynove (westbound) and Bashkanskyi district (2 reactive Shaheds from Kherson), plus a drone near Berezanka heading to Odesa. (Source: @kpszsu/88007, @kpszsu/88030, @mon1tor_ua/77172)

Russian strike groups (Udarny Bp) active in Mykolaiv (1-2 groups), Kherson (1 group), and Dnipropetrovsk (3 groups) oblasts, supporting frontline operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/124209, @eRadarrua/124218, @eRadarrua/124224)
A Geran-5 missile launched from Dnipropetrovsk toward Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi district), crossing the southern-central boundary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77172)

Kyiv experienced multiple air raid alerts: yellow (drone) at 18:20, red (missile) at 19:46, red at 20:00, with all-clears at 18:43, 20:00, and 20:06 on October 18, 2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/124197, @eRadarrua/124215, @eRadarrua/124216, @eRadarrua/124217, @eRadarrua/124220)

Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles penetrated deep into western Ukraine: Rivne (multiple impacts), Khmelnytskyi (near nuclear plant), Ternopil (energy infrastructure fires), Lviv (logistics complex and homes), and Vinnytsia (multiple drone tracks). (Source: @eRadarrua/124213, @mon1tor_ua/77187, @mon1tor_ua/77178, @mon1tor_ua/77183)

Russian drone launch sites at Orel, Guardiyskoye, and Millerovo released at least 11 groups of Shaheds, while Ukrainian monitoring tracked individual drones across Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, Poltava, and Khmelnytskyi oblasts. (Source: @eRadarrua/124212, @kpszsu/88041, @kpszsu/88024, @kpszsu/88038, @kpszsu/88016, @kpszsu/88047, @kpszsu/88053, @kpszsu/88009)

Geran-5 rocket-powered drones used in strike role against Poltava, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Rivne, and Khmelnytskyi, with some designated as 'reactive' (jet-propelled) variants. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77181, @mon1tor_ua/77175, @mon1tor_ua/77180, @mon1tor_ua/77187, @mon1tor_ua/77178)
Ukrainian air defense engaged targets near Khmelnytskyi Nuclear Power Plant as a Shahed drone flew toward it, highlighting nuclear safety risks. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77154)

key_developments: Russia launched a massive combined aerial attack on October 18, 2026, with Shahed drones from 7+ directions, Geran-5 missiles striking 5+ cities, and a ballistic missile threat of ~30 Iskander-M/S-400/Zircon from Bryansk/Kursk/Millerovo targeting Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77149, @eRadarrua/124211)

Ukrainian drones struck Saint Petersburg overnight, hitting a railway bridge, oil terminal, VK data center, and substation, causing power outages in the city and Leningrad oblast. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)

Russian strikes damaged energy infrastructure in Rivne (facility halted), Ternopil (fires at energy sites), and Lviv (logistics complex, 9 homes damaged), with no casualties reported in Lviv. (Source: @eRadarrua/124213)

US intelligence warns of another massive Russian ballistic missile strike within 48 hours, with 24 missiles (Iskander, S-400, Oniks, Zircon) prepared at launch sites targeting energy, transport, and defense industry. (Source: @UkraineNow/84749)

Kyiv endured three separate air raid alerts (two red, one yellow) with all-clears issued, indicating sustained missile and drone threat over the capital throughout the evening. (Source: @eRadarrua/124215, @eRadarrua/124216, @eRadarrua/124217, @eRadarrua/124220)

Russian drone launch sites at Orel (5 groups), Guardiyskoye (2 groups), and Millerovo (4 groups) activated simultaneously, demonstrating coordinated large-scale drone deployment capability. (Source: @eRadarrua/124212)

A Shahed drone approached the Khmelnytskyi Nuclear Power Plant, prompting emergency monitoring, while Geran-5 missiles impacted near Rivne, Zhytomyr, and Khmelnytskyi population centers. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77154, @mon1tor_ua/77187)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is executing a complex, multi-axis aerial campaign combining slow-moving Shahed drones, rocket-powered Geran-5 missiles, and imminent ballistic missile threats to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses. The simultaneous activation of launch sites at Orel, Guardiyskoye, and Millerovo suggests a deliberate saturation strategy. The US warning of 24 prepared ballistic missiles indicates a potential follow-on strike targeting critical infrastructure. Ukrainian air defense is engaged across a vast area from Chernihiv to Lviv, but the penetration of Geran-5 missiles to western cities and the approach to Khmelnytskyi NPP reveal gaps in coverage. The Saint Petersburg attack demonstrates Ukraine's growing long-range strike capability, likely forcing Russian air defense redeployment.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian monitoring networks (eRadar, mon1tor, kpszsu) provided real-time tracking of drone trajectories and missile launches, enabling timely air raid alerts. The Kyiv city administration managed multiple alert cycles effectively. Emergency services in Rivne, Ternopil, and Lviv are responding to infrastructure damage. International partners, particularly the US, are sharing strategic warning intelligence on Russian missile preparations. No immediate NATO or EU collective response statements appear in the source data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of Geran-5 (rocket-powered Shahed variants) in significant numbers marks an evolution in Russian one-way attack drone tactics, offering higher speed and reduced interception windows. The 'Banderol' missile tracked in Poltava suggests continued Kh-59/69 employment. Russian drone launch groups at Orel, Guardiyskoye, and Millerovo correspond to known Shahed deployment airfields. The ballistic missile threat from Bryansk/Kursk/Millerovo aligns with known Iskander and coastal defense missile (Zircon/Oniks) basing. Ukrainian drone operations against Saint Petersburg indicate expanded range and targeting of Russian energy and communications infrastructure.
